messages.subject: Webinar: Limitation of liability clauses post-2025 - book now
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Practitioner,

Join our CPD webinar "Drafting and negotiating limitation of liability clauses: lessons from recent cases" on 11 March, 12:30-13:30. 1 CPD hour. Members £45, non-members £75.

Book online at lawsociety.org.uk/events.

The Law Society Events Team
